title: Six Fins Jet Ski Rental - Hurricane Hole
specs: Trashmore Submarine Pits Overwater Transmission Towers / Powerline Pylons Boca Chica Sandbar – Relax and swim at this hidden gem Spot dolphins, sea turtles, and more Note: Tour route may vary depending on weather conditions.
Policies Check-In & Requirements Insurance Waivers and Boater Safety Course must be completed before arrival.
Drivers must also carry photo ID while on the water, as required by Florida law.
Every driver must be able to understand them.
All minors must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.
Cancellation Policy Cancellations must be made at least 48 hours before departure to receive a refund.
Alcohol Policy No alcohol before the tour.
Guests under the influence or with alcohol will not be permitted to ride and will not be refunded.

Tour Highlights Southernmost Point – Snap a photo at the iconic marker Boca Chica Sandbar – Relax and swim at this hidden gem Spot dolphins, sea turtles, and more Wrecks Free ride areas Note: Tour route may vary depending on weather conditions.
